permitted_use: Use the ten-record sample as a standards-mapping proof of concept.
Use TEI locators and Web Annotation TextQuoteSelector values as non-image selector leads.
Use the result to define what a later coordinate-level critical edition must add.
forbidden_use: Do not claim a complete IIIF critical edition.
Do not claim pixel-level source annotation.
Do not claim reviewed glyph images or public image release.
article_implication: Article 5 can report a TEI/Web Annotation selector-layer mapping sample, but a critical edition still requires pixel coordinates, source-image rights, and human glyph review.
